name: Form Capture + Confirmation

parameters.formDescription: Tell us what is going on and we will get you scheduled right away.

values.formSubmittedText: Thanks! Your request is in. We are scheduling your appointment now and you will receive a confirmation text shortly.

parameters.jsCode:
const src = ($json.body && typeof $json.body === 'object') ? $json.body : $json;
const g = k => (src[k] !== undefined && src[k] !== null) ? src[k] : '';
return [{ json: {
  source: 'Website Form',
  firstName: g('First Name') || g('firstName'),
  lastName: g('Last Name') || g('lastName'),
  phone: g('Phone') || g('phone'),
  email: g('Email') || g('email'),
  address: g('Address') || g('address'),
  serviceNeeded: g('Service Needed') || g('serviceNeeded'),
  description: g('Description') || g('description'),
  photosLink: g('Photos Link') || g('photosLink'),
  preferredDate: g('Preferred Date') || g('preferredDate'),
  preferredTime: g('Preferred Time') || g('preferredTime'),
  status: 'New',
  logChannel: 'Website Form',
  logDirection: 'Inbound',
  logHandler: 'System',
  logSummary: 'New lead submitted via website form',
  logNotes: ''
}}];

const lead = $('Build Confirmation SMS').first().json;
return [{ json: {
  source: lead.source,
  firstName: lead.firstName,
  lastName: lead.lastName,
  phone: lead.phone,
  email: lead.email,
  address: lead.address,
  serviceNeeded: lead.serviceNeeded,
  leadId: lead.leadId,
  confirmedDate: lead.confirmedDate,
  confirmedTime: lead.confirmedTime,
  schedulingFailed: lead.schedulingFailed,
  logChannel: 'SMS',
  logDirection: 'Outbound',
  logHandler: 'System',
  logSummary: lead.schedulingFailed ? 'Sent fallback confirmation SMS (auto-scheduling failed)' : ('Sent confirmation SMS — appointment auto-scheduled for ' + lead.confirmedDate + ' at ' + lead.confirmedTime),
  logNotes: lead.smsMessage
}}];

const lead = $('Build Confirmation SMS').first().json;
return [{ json: {
  source: lead.source || '',
  firstName: lead.firstName || '',
  lastName: lead.lastName || '',
  phone: lead.phone || '',
  email: lead.email || '',
  address: lead.address || '',
  serviceNeeded: lead.serviceNeeded || '',
  description: lead.description || '',
  preferredDate: lead.preferredDate || '',
  preferredTime: lead.preferredTime || '',
  leadId: lead.leadId || '',
  confirmedDate: lead.confirmedDate || '',
  confirmedTime: lead.confirmedTime || '',
  schedulingFailed: !!lead.schedulingFailed,
  status: lead.schedulingFailed ? 'New' : 'Booked'
}}];

parameters.content: Captures website form submissions, upserts the lead, AUTO-SCHEDULES the next available appointment (no owner approval needed), sends the customer a confirmation SMS with the real date/time, logs all communication, and sends an Every Lead Alert to the owner for every submission.

description: Form capture (n8n form + optional webhook) -> CRM Adapter upserts lead to Sheets -> Haiku 4.5 sends a confirmation SMS -> logs outbound -> sends an Every Lead Alert (email by default, SMS optional) to the owner for every submission.
